players.product: on-premises superconducting quantum computers (five-qubit IQM Spark; IQM Radiance, approximately 20 to 150 qubits) and IQM Resonance cloud

quarterly_data.signal: IQM prospectus, fiscal 2025 (IFRS, EUR thousand): revenue 31,333, up 91% from 16,436, with gross margin 48% (2024: 31%); revenue came from 22 unique customers versus eight in 2024. Four customers (not named) each contributed 10% or more of revenue in 2025 and in 2024 - in 2025 Customer 1 6,028, Customer 2 2,085, Customer 3 8,973 and Customer 4 6,300 - and single customers accounted for 29%, 20% and 19% of 2025 revenue; in the first half of 2026 one customer accounted for 43% and a second for 40%. 2025 revenue by customer domicile: Finland 11,473, Italy 7,316, Germany 6,482, Czech Republic 2,085, Taiwan 2,030; in Q2 2026 revenue from the USA was 3,625 of 6,683.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2025 revenue EUR 31,333 thousand (+91%); 22 unique customers (2024: eight); H1 2026 two customers at 43% and 40%
